description: Selector/action-robustness probes (qc01.3) — non-unique or hard-to-address controls: three identical 'Edit' buttons (disambiguate by row name), a Confirm button covered by an overlay (must dismiss first), and a Submit disabled until a field is filled.

scenarios.goal: Log in, go to /robustness/duplicate-text, and click the 'Edit' button belonging to the row named 'Bravo' (the second row).
Log in, go to /robustness/covered, dismiss the overlay notice that covers the page, then click the Confirm button.
Log in, go to /robustness/disabled-submit, type a name into the field to enable the Submit button, then click Submit.
